name: dbs_react_daas
description: digiBank-style MFE demo — React 18 + Module Federation 2.0 + Rsbuild/Rspack + React Router v7 + Zustand + Tailwind CSS + TypeScript. Host owns routing; per-feature remote MFEs (auth, dashboard, payments, digiWealth, accounts) are mounted at runtime.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n host,auth,dash,pay,wlth,accts -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow,blue,red "npm run dev -w @daas/host" "npm run dev -w @daas/remote-auth" "npm run dev -w @daas/remote-dashboard" "npm run dev -w @daas/remote-payments" "npm run dev -w @daas/remote-wealth" "npm run dev -w @daas/remote-accounts"
scripts.dev:core: concurrently -n host,auth,dash,pay,wlth -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow,blue "npm run dev -w @daas/host" "npm run dev -w @daas/remote-auth" "npm run dev -w @daas/remote-dashboard" "npm run dev -w @daas/remote-payments" "npm run dev -w @daas/remote-wealth"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @daas/remote-auth && npm run build -w @daas/remote-dashboard && npm run build -w @daas/remote-payments && npm run build -w @daas/remote-wealth && npm run build -w @daas/remote-accounts && npm run build -w @daas/host
scripts.preview: concurrently -n host,auth,dash,pay,wlth,accts -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow,blue,red "npm run preview -w @daas/host" "npm run preview -w @daas/remote-auth" "npm run preview -w @daas/remote-dashboard" "npm run preview -w @daas/remote-payments" "npm run preview -w @daas/remote-wealth" "npm run preview -w @daas/remote-accounts"
scripts.install:dbs: npm install @dbs/webstudio-hub-athena-daas@latest --workspace @daas/host --save-optional || echo "[install:dbs] SDK unavailable (public registry 404) - skipped, project still compiles"
